caption:
Scared honesty will cost the relationship? You’ve misread love. (1 Timothy 1:3–5 devotional)

Paul charges Timothy to correct false teaching — but names the goal as love from a pure heart. Honesty rooted in love doesn't break a relationship; it builds one. Every hard word aims not to win, but to heal.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
